files.patch:
- return session.expiresAt > Date.now();
+ return session.expiresAt > Date.now() || Boolean(session.refreshToken);

files.src/auth/session.ts: export function isSessionValid(session) { return session.expiresAt > Date.now() || Boolean(session.refreshToken); }
files.src/middleware/permissions.ts: export function authorize(session) { if (!isSessionValid(session)) return deny(); return allow(); }
